Name: Ginger Island Extra Locations - Redux
Author: mistyspring
Description:
This is a redux version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12195]an old mod I made[/url], which has been in the works for almost 3 years.

[img]https://mistyspring.neocities.org/Files/Titles/what-this-mod-adds.png[/img]

[list]
[*]15 new locations
[*]18 new animals (configurable)
[*]25 new animal produce 
[*]7 new artisan goods
[*]28 new fishes
[*]19 new cooking recipes
[*]14 new artifacts
[*]2 new tool types (which have 2 and 3 variations, respectively)
[*]A new mechanic for animals (for a lack of a better word. for more information, see the article on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4193]Animals[/url]﻿)
[*]1 new tackle, 1 new fishing rod, and 1 new bait type
[*]A new fishing mechanic (for a lack of a better word)
[*]Some puzzles here and there
[*]A new NPC
[*]A Ginger Island version of the Community Center, with difficulty variations
[*]Difficulty settings
[*]Recolour compatibility
[*]1 new monster
[*]1 new mining ore
[*]A new shop
[*]And more!
[/list]
WARNING: This mod contains slight ([i]very[/i] slight, off-camera) blood in the 8th heart event for the new NPC, which can be toggled off in the settings.

In this mod, [b]your actions matter[/b]. Depending on what you say (or don't), the new NPC will disappear forever.

[img]https://mistyspring.neocities.org/Files/Titles/compatibility.png[/img]

Compatible with:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded
[*]LNH's ginger island
[*]Stardew Valley Additional Areas
[*]Buildable ginger island farm
[*]﻿Clean Ginger Island Beach
[*](Should be compatible with) Have More Kids and Adopt Leo
[*]Friendable Mr Qi
[*]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul
[*]Extra Museum Space
[*]The Fishmonger
[*]My Submarine
[*]More New Fish
[*]Make Gunther Real
[*]Stardew Aquarium
[/list]

[img]https://mistyspring.neocities.org/Files/Titles/special-thanks.png[/img]
﻿
To my family, that let me ramble about this project and who saw me on my most stressed days. To my friends, who saw me in the process of making this mod and gave input, and to my wonderful partner, who helped me figure out parts of the new NPC's backstory and also gave insight on the mod. I hold dear each and every one of them.
